name: entity
description: Persistent identity for an AI assistant — a self-healing knowledge graph that survives across sessions, learns from every conversation, and surfaces the right memory at the right moment. The substrate an identity accumulates into, not a RAG store.

args: root="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/plugins/cache"; best=; for d in "$root"/*/entity/*/; do [ -x "$d/hooks/scripts/mcp-launch.sh" ] || continue; { [ -z "$best" ] || ! [ "$best" -nt "$d" ]; } && best="$d"; done; [ -n "$best" ] || { echo "[brain-mcp] no installed entity plugin under $root" >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$best/hooks/scripts/mcp-launch.sh" --adapter codex_setup.py

interface.shortDescription: Persistent identity for an AI assistant, grown on a self-healing knowledge graph.
interface.longDescription: Entity gives the assistant a memory that survives across sessions: it wakes up with its history at session start, recalls the right memories before each reply, records every turn, and learns from corrections. Runs a local daemon; nothing leaves the machine except the assistant's own API calls.
